Class SyncManager<K>

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SyncManager<K>
Type Parameters:
K - java type of RowSet's key; same as <K> in associated SsDbComboBox2
public class SyncManager<K> extends Object
Used to synchronize a data navigator and a navigation ComboBox. The combobox may contain the original row number, see DbSupport.createRownumQuery(String, String, String, String), SsDbComboBox2.setD2ColumnName(String) and setComboHasRowNum(boolean)
Otherwise: The SsDbComboBox2 and the RowSet queries should select the same records and in the same order; if not, the SSSyncManager will spend a lot of time looping through records to match.
